data.message: All 24 others: I opt in to 18 tons, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run income may suffer. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each person: what's your exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
